estimates: OEM owner manual height is 1680mm/66.1in; press kit and sales brochure both say65.0in. Use press/brochure1651mm provisionally and retain discrepancy, not an exact consensus.
Manual metric wheelbase2530, width1695, tracks1475/1480 differ slightly from direct inch conversions because of rounding.
6400 is published maximum engine speed, not verified fuel-cut calibration.
Idle numeric rpm, CG height, sprung/unsprung split, springs/dampers, torque curve away from peak, clutch and shift timing, frontal area and performance claims not verified.
Do not add a complete fuel tank or driver mass to curb weight blindly; follow runtime mass convention and disclose approximation.
ABLS is brake-based assistance, not a verified mechanical limited-slip differential.
Owner manual covers optional trims; base tires are selected using S-specific brochure/press table.
Use press/brochure65in height1.651m provisionally, not owner-manual1.680m. Inch conversions for all dimensions are consistent; source discrepancy retained.

2798lb base curb mass is used directly as requested by runtime convention; no extra driver/full fuel mass added. The source does not specify fuel fill fraction. Axle masses1644/1154 derive approximately58.756percent front, versus rounded59percent table.

6400 maximum speed is used as an estimated runtime limiter,6200 redline and750idle are estimates, not OEM fuel-cut data. CGheight.58m,front/rear overhang split,collision shape,27USmpg,105mph/9.5sec performance displays,off-anchor torque curve,450ms shifts/100ms clutch/2200launch and normalized suspension/handling/brake settings are explicit game-calibration estimates.
No mechanical LSD inferred from brake-based ABLS. Shared tire smoke/spray does not imply continuous exhaust smoke. Original logo-free2994 art will not be a real manufacturer replica.
